image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (polyplacophore) clinging to a rocky, wet substrate. The organism has an oval shape with eight distinct, overlapping dorsal plates (valves) that are reddish-brown with mottled patterns and textured surfaces. The plates are surrounded by a leathery girdle that appears spiny or granular. The background consists of dark, wet rocks and small pebbles.
